raw:
The paper proposes a multi-agent framework that includes retrieval-augmented generation as one component, and it runs experiments with ablations. The central question is whether E9 (multimodal-only RAG) applies. The framework is multimodal, but the abstract does not say that the retrieval is multimodal. Retrieval may well be text-based, with the MLLM taking image input. The E9 exclusion is for "clearly" multimodal-only RAG, and that is not clear here. RAG is only one module of several, and the paper does run experiments. I lean toward MAYBE, or possibly INCLUDE. Since RAG is a named component and experiments are run, but the multimodal nature and the unclear retrieval modality make it uncertain, MAYBE is the safer call.

{"decision": "MAYBE", "code": null, "reason": "Multimodal multi-agent framework with RAG module; unclear whether retrieval is multimodal-only (E9) or text."}
